reason: Genuine port. One missing-header check per doc: a `select_when` content regex `\A(?:#![^\n]*\n)?(?<AFTER>)` anchors at offset 0, or at the start of the line after a shebang (capture.AFTER), and fires when the `program` has no qualifying first comment; an empty file is a program without one, so it needs no separate check. The trailing-newline check is a content regex anchored at \A; the header regex is a rule option, ported through overrides. Every failure is zero-width.

evidence.why: TSLint reports at 2:1 (offset after `#!...\n`); the empty AFTER group starts there, while `program` starts at 1:1
